gates.criterion: Foundation contracts and governance independently reviewed and integrated
Cryptographically verified actor identity and secure session lifecycle
Server-enforced device, subject, tenant isolation and owner list/revocation
Authenticated payment/refund authority, replay safe and reconciliation
Signed grant, issuer trust, device/node/session binding, replay, expiry and revocation
Authentic node source, capacity, scoped verifier and revocation enforcement
Actual native tunnel integration and accurate protected-state reporting
Real-device OS-specific DNS/IPv4/IPv6 route and outage leak measurement
Field inventory, technical log/trace scrubbing, retention/deletion and provider disclosures
Key compromise, node failure, restore and offline-policy drills
Mandatory reproducible suites and current-head required GitHub status
Non-author independent security review and exact-head signoff
Applicable legal, store and religious/ethical gates recorded
